siteMetadata.title: Cedric Sarigumba
siteMetadata.description: Welcome to my corner of the internet.

frontmatter.title: Keeping Some Things Close
frontmatter.description: Some parts of a good life are better protected from the pressure to explain, prove, or perform them.

frontmatter.title: Don't Wrestle the River
frontmatter.description: Other people do not get to decide my inner state. A simple practice for responding to disregard without pretending it is acceptable.

frontmatter.title: Am I Using My Ego, or Is It Using Me?
frontmatter.description: The quickest way to your own downfall is to stop examining yourself and start believing you're better than you are. A journal entry for me, and for my sons.

frontmatter.title: Learning to Enjoy Your Own Company
frontmatter.description: Learning to be alone, not lonely, is one of the best things you can do for yourself. It builds self-reliance, quiet confidence, and a clearer sense of who you actually are.

frontmatter.title: The Line I Say to Myself
frontmatter.description: One sentence I repeat to myself keeps difficult people from running my day. Here's how a mantra works as a filter.

frontmatter.title: The One Question That Quietly Improved My Life
frontmatter.description: A simple question I ask myself in every moment to choose the best next action and live with less regret.

frontmatter.title: I Won't Be Commanded, I Won't Be Controlled
frontmatter.description: A song that keeps reminding me to be loyal to my own voice. Why authenticity is the precondition for speaking freely.

frontmatter.title: Imagine Losing It, Then Look Again
frontmatter.description: Imagining the worst sounds pessimistic. For me, it's the practice that keeps me grateful for what I still have.

frontmatter.title: What Epictetus Taught Me About Letting Go
frontmatter.description: Some people suffer twice. Once while doing the work, and again while worrying about the result. Here's what Epictetus taught me about focusing on what I can control.

frontmatter.title: Don't Sweat the Small Stuff - I Disagree
frontmatter.description: Everyone says to let the little things go. I think that's wrong - here's why the small stuff is actually the big stuff in disguise.

frontmatter.title: Hard Things Build Character
frontmatter.description: Finishing 500km over Christmas week taught me more about focus and self-control than I expected.

frontmatter.title: If I Can Recommend One Book, It Will Be Meditations
Why You Need a Personal Mission Statement
frontmatter.description: Are You Going Somewhere, or Just Busy?
